name: What is the difference between a modular and a custom outdoor kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a modular and a custom outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A modular outdoor kitchen consists of pre-fabricated units that are assembled on-site. These are typically more budget-friendly and offer quicker installation but have limited customization options. A custom outdoor kitchen, on the other hand, is built from scratch to fit your specific space and preferences. Custom kitchens allow for unique layouts, materials, and features, providing a personalized design that perfectly integrates with your home's aesthetic, though they generally involve higher costs and longer build times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modular outdoor kitchens use pre-fabricated units for quicker, more affordable installation, while custom kitchens are built uniquely for your space with greater personalization.
